title: Chapter 260 The Competition Ends
content:
Chapter 260 The Competition Ends

On the other hand, the people from Tiandi Academy looked at Lu Xue in front of Lu Daosheng with shock.

"She, she is the daughter of the Lord of the Huangcheng City!"

A disciple of the Alchemy Peak said in a bit unbelievable.

The other disciples of the Alchemy Peak were inexplicably scared and quickly turned their heads to look at Bai Lushuang.

After all, Lu Xue would speak wildly when she entered the alchemy and was driven out by Bai Lushuang.

And now, Lu Xue's amazing identity made them feel a little scared.

If Lu Xue pursued this matter, with the strength that Huangcheng has shown now, they would definitely not have any good results.

Thinking of this, everyone in Liandan Peak hurriedly lowered their heads tightly.

This is done by Senior Sister Bai and has nothing to do with them.

Several people thought so in their hearts.

Bai Lushuang's face was also a little pale.

At this moment, she finally understood what Lu Xue said at the alchemy meeting.

What a big talk.

That's the truth that people told.

The pills refined by her disciples who were waiting for the alchemy peak were really nothing in her eyes.

No wonder Lu Xue would say something she wouldn't pick it up even if she threw it on the ground.

Bai Lushuang smiled bitterly, and her heart was very complicated.

On the side, Tan Songci did not notice the abnormality of the students around him, but sighed and said with a smile: "Haha, my academy has a profound impact. Even a terrifying force like the Huangcheng City will turn its own world. The proud daughter was sent to the academy to study.”

Tan Songci smiled at this moment.

Did you see that the daughters of the Lord of Huangcheng City are all studying in their academy, don’t you understand?

Tiandi Academy is the general trend.

At this time, a student under Tan Songci suddenly came to Tan Songci, muttered a few words, and looked at Bai Lushuang while saying this.

After a while, Tan Songci frowned and turned his head to look at Bai Lushuang.

"Is this kind of thing there?"

The student nodded, "Teacher, these things are seen by students at the alchemy meeting with their own eyes, so naturally they cannot be faked. Not only students, but many people saw them at the alchemy meeting at that time."

Hearing this, Tan Songci suddenly realized the seriousness of the matter.

If it were an ordinary person, he might just scold him.

But this time the target is different.

Lu Xue.

That is the pearl in the palm of the Huangcheng City Lord!

Until now, the terrifying scene I saw outside the deserted city was deeply engraved in Tan Songci's heart.

etc!

Suddenly, Tan Songci's face changed and he suddenly looked at Jordanyang on the stage.

At this moment, he suddenly understood a lot of things.

For example, Jordan Yang will conduct an alchemy competition here.

Based on his understanding of Jordanyang, how could he be here to conduct an alchemy competition in the Wood Fairy World?

There is only one reason, that is, Jordan Yang is forced.

So that's it, so that's it.

Tan Songci narrowed his eyes slightly, and glanced vigilantly at the dark corner of the square.

And at this time, An Xing was slightly shocked.

The subordinates on the side also changed their faces, "Sir, did that old man find us?"

Upon hearing this, An Xing did not answer, but chuckled, "This old guy is really a bit powerful."

"Then do we have to continue?"

An Xing was silent for a moment and said, "It depends on the situation."

"Look at what this old man will do about this matter."

"Yes, sir."

In the square.

Tan Songci pondered for a long time, and finally shouted, "Bai Lushuang."

When Bai Lushuang heard Tan Songci call him, he paused and was immediately pulled back to reality from his thoughts.

"Teacher, you call me?"

Bai Lushuang walked to Tan Songci, feeling a little ups and downs.

She is not a person who bullies the weak and is afraid of the strong, but this time, she is really a little scared.

Because the other party's identity is too terrifying.

This is a force that she could not imagine, from the unknown terror.

Even as a student of the Tiandi Academy and a disciple under Jordan Yang, she could not feel safe when she provoked such a force.

Because at this moment, she was within the other party's power.

Just when she thought Tan Songci was going to ask what.

There was a snap.

A crisp sound rang out of the field.

Everyone around him was shocked and looked over suddenly. He saw a deep red palm print on Bai Lushuang's fair cheeks.

A trace of blood was revealed and the corner of the mouth was slowly left.

At this moment, Bai Lushuang was a little confused, but the most was still grievance.

This is the first time she has been beaten since she was a child.

She wanted to ask why.

But Tan Songci did not stop.

Bang!

Another slap, and it was much stronger than the previous slap.

Of course, no matter how big it is, Tan Songci didn't use all his strength.

After all, with his cultivation level, he would have a full blown attack. At this moment, Bai Lushuang would be the same as the same as the same.

And this time, Bai Lushuang was unstable and was slapped to the ground.

Bai Lushuang could no longer hold it back, and tears kept sliding from the corners of her eyes, which looked very pitiful.

But at this moment, none of the people in the Tiandi Academy around came forward to stop it.

The one who once praised her no longer stood up.

As for the rest of the people around them, they all looked like watching the show.

Tan Songci looked cold and said, he was very enthusiastic when he should be enthusiastic when he should be serious, but he was absolutely unambiguous when he should be serious.

Looking at Bai Lushuang, who was beaten in front of her, who had vomited blood and had a chaotic breath, Tan Songci did not have any sympathy.

He is saving her.

"Bai Lushuang, I've made a decision for your teacher. After returning to the academy, I will remove your position as a disciple of the Alchemy Peak, enter Wuya Mountain, and face the wall to think about your mistakes."

Tan Songci said coldly.

Then two disciples from the Alchemy Peak drove Bai Lushuang to the corner.

In the dark.

All of this was seen by An Xing and couldn't help but laugh.

"Hahaha."

On the side, the black shadow hesitated: "Sir, then we,"

Upon hearing this, An Xing chuckled and said, "Forget it, let's stop here. Miss, she probably doesn't have the heart to pay attention to this person."

Because at this moment, on the competition platform.

"Xiaoxue, Dad talks to you about something serious."

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue in front of him with a serious look on his face and spoke slowly.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

Is my dad looking for me?

"What's the matter?"

Lu Xue asked.

Lu Daosheng was about to speak when he suddenly thought of everyone around him.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng turned around and took a step, saying, "This time, the alchemy competition is over. Where do you come from and where do you go back."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

An irresistible force swept across everyone present.

Anyone who is not a deserted city, without exception, was sent out of the deserted city at this moment.

Outside the deserted city, everyone looked confused.

Some people who wanted to enter the deserted city again suddenly realized that the deserted city could not enter the deserted city at this moment.

A powerful forbidden crossed the gate of the deserted city, blocking their way.

Seeing this, some people left here immediately.

The same is true for Tan Songci.

"Brother Qiao."

"Huh? Old Tan, are you here too?"

Jordanyang was also sent out of the deserted city and met Tan Songci and others outside the city gate.

At this time, Jordanyang noticed Bai Lushuang, who was in extremely poor condition, and his brows frowned slightly.

Seeing this, Tan Songci shook his head slightly.

"Let's go back to the academy."

Upon hearing this, Jordanyang also put away his smile and then headed towards the direction of the Immortal Realm with Tan Songci.
